maddeler.e:
نصالح (form VI)
# نَصَّالَحُ (naṣṣālaḥu) /nasˤ.sˤaː.la.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصَّالَحَ (iṣṣālaḥa)
# نَصَّالَحَ (naṣṣālaḥa) /nasˤ.sˤaː.la.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِصَّالَحَ (iṣṣālaḥa)
# نَصَّالَحْ (naṣṣālaḥ) /nasˤ.sˤaː.laħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِصَّالَحَ (iṣṣālaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
